1.0.0.title: Nouvelles Fonctionnalités de Mamadera 1.0.0
items: ### Nouvelles fonctionnalités
- Update FeedingSubtype enum and migrate database values
- Update dialog button labels to use 'Confirm' instead of 'Save' and adjust localization
- Refactor dialog buttons and add quantity picker functionality
- Add close button to dialogs and localize button text in English and French
- Update project settings and improve theme consistency across screens
- Refactor theme usage across history, home, menu, and reminders screens
- Show onboarding dialog based on baby profile existence state
- Implement anyBabyExistsProvider to manage baby profile existence state
- Enhance home screen with duration picker, reminder pill, and waste dialog
- Add baby profile and onboarding flow
- Add resetDatabase function to delete SQLite file and recreate DB
- Add ReminderPill widget tests and enhance TrackButton tests
- Implement reminders feature with notifier, repository, and UI integration
- Enforce unique constraint on itemId in ReminderDismissals table
- Update schema to version 3 with primary key constraints and migration logic
- Implement reminders repository and related entities
- Implement theme service for persistent theme preferences
- Add localization support for health subtypes and menu language selection
- Add unit tests for tracking enums and related entities
- Remove Gitleaks action from CI workflow
- Upgrade Gitleaks action to v3 and update environment variable for no-git option
- Update Gitleaks action version and enhance local audit command options
- Update CI configuration to enhance Gitleaks usage and streamline local CI commands
- Enhance CI configuration with non-blocking Trivy audit and improved coverage checks
- Update CI workflow to use latest action versions and improve consistency
- Update Gitleaks configuration and add ignore list for known false positives
- Revamp README with detailed features, architecture overview, and privacy/security information
- Enhance CI pipeline with coverage checks and add Makefile for local CI commands
- Implement encryption for sensitive notes and migrate existing data
- Refactor theme and bottom navigation components, update pubspec dependencies
- Enhance code quality and structure with strict analysis options, improved logging, and refactored components
- Implement Tracking Repository and Refactor Home Screen
- Implement local database service and history tracking features
### Corrections de bugs
- Correct variable reference in lcov summary extraction for accurate coverage reporting
